milestone.title: Durable video-job processing (Redis queue + restart recovery)
milestone.goal: A video-generation job survives a gateway restart: jobs are enqueued to the existing Redis, processed by an in-process worker, and any job orphaned by a restart is recovered and re-driven — with bounded retries and at-least-once idempotency — reusing the existing Redis with zero new infra.

durable-video-queue.title: Redis-backed durable queue + worker + restart recovery for video jobs
